item.title: Bad Bunny wins album of the year at the 2026 Grammy Awards, first for Spanish-language album
item.description: The 68th annual Grammy Awards took placed Sunday in Los Angeles. Bad Bunny has won album of the year, the first time a Spanish-language album has taken the Grammys' top honor.

item.title: 2 kids sledding hit by car in Chesterfield neighborhood, sources tell Jon Burkett
item.description: Two children on a sled were struck by a car in a Chesterfield neighborhood on Sunday afternoon, Crime Insider sources told Jon Burkett.

item.title: Buddhist monks on Walk for Peace to host gathering in Richmond on sixth day in Virginia
item.description: A group of Buddhist monks on a 2,300-mile Walk for Peace will make their way to Richmond on their sixth day in Virginia.
